
name: QSVM Research Experiment

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_mode:
        description: "Choose which experiment to run"
        required: true
        default: smoke
        type: choice
        options:
          - smoke
          - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  run-experiment:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 300

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: requirements-repro-lock.txt

      - name: Install dependencies
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install -r requirements-repro-lock.txt --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu

      - name: Prepare data directory
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force data/raw | Out-Null

      - name: Download GSE2034 for main experiment
        if: inputs.run_mode == 'main'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $url = "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE2nnn/GSE2034/matrix/GSE2034_series_matrix.txt.gz"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile "data/raw/GSE2034_series_matrix.txt.gz"
          if (!(Test-Path "data/raw/GSE2034_series_matrix.txt.gz")) {
            throw "GSE2034 download failed"
          }

      - name: Run unit tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          if ("${{ inputs.run_mode }}" -eq "main") {
            python -m pytest tests -q
          } else {
            python -m pytest tests -q -k "not test_gse2034_loader"
          }

      - name: Run smoke test
        if: inputs.run_mode == 'smoke'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          python scripts/run_experiment.py --config configs/smoke_test.yaml

      - name: Run main experiment
        if: inputs.run_mode == 'main'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          if (Test-Path "configs/tier_a_single.yaml") {
            python scripts/run_experiment.py --config configs/tier_a_single.yaml
          } else {
            python scripts/run_experiment.py --config configs/tier_a_main.yaml
          }

      - name: Upload experiment results and logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: qsvm-experiment-results
          path: |
            results/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
